title: ARSIA Capability Policy
description: JSON document maintained by the receiving organization that defines which capabilities are available to external agents and under what conditions. Input to Phase 3 (Capability Scoping) of the onboarding flow (ARSIA-Identity.md §7.4). Defined in ARSIA-Identity.md §8.1. The policy evaluation procedure in §8.3 is deny-by-default: capabilities not listed in the policy are rejected.

policy_version.description: Version identifier for the policy, included in the onboarding decision to record which version was applied. Implementations SHOULD use a semantically meaningful version string (e.g. 'finco-2026-q1', 'v2.1'). Format is free-form. Per ARSIA-Identity.md §8.1 'policy_version'.

token_lifetime_seconds.description: Lifetime in seconds of access tokens issued to approved external agents. Tokens MUST NOT be issued with a lifetime exceeding this value. RECOMMENDED minimum 900 (15 minutes); RECOMMENDED maximum 86400 (24 hours). Values outside this range are permitted but implementations SHOULD log a warning. Per ARSIA-Identity.md §8.1 'token_lifetime_seconds'.

capabilities.description: Array of CapabilityRule entries defining the organization's policy for each capability. Per ARSIA-Identity.md §8.1 'capabilities' and §8.2 CapabilityRule structure.

allOf.description: The capability string, conforming to the ARSIA capability naming grammar (ARSIA-Actions.md §1.1). Wildcard capabilities (e.g. 'arsiaprotocol.test.*') are NOT permitted in policy rules — each rule MUST specify an exact capability. Per ARSIA-Identity.md §8.2 'capability'.

status.description: Policy status for this capability. 'allowed': capability is freely permitted. 'oversight_required': capability is permitted but requires human oversight for each invocation. 'prohibited': capability is explicitly denied. Semantics defined in ARSIA-Identity.md §7.4. Per ARSIA-Identity.md §8.2 'status'.

max_risk_level.description: Maximum risk level (per ARSIA-Actions.md §2.2) at which this capability may be invoked. If the action's declared risk level exceeds this value, the invocation MUST be treated as prohibited regardless of the status field. Per ARSIA-Identity.md §8.2 'max_risk_level'.

conditions.description: Human-readable description of the conditions under which this capability is available. Informational only — included in audit records but NOT machine-enforced. Per ARSIA-Identity.md §8.2 'conditions'.
